description: Dictate into a BB draft by holding Space, then release to finish. Enter finishes recording without sending, Escape cancels, and Ctrl+Shift+Space toggles recording without holding a key. Microphone tooltips and modifier-held badges show the controls beside BB’s native buttons. Requires BB 0.46.1+, microphone permission and an available BB voice-input service; that service’s existing account requirements and charges still apply, with no additional speech service installed.
